Maybe *some* MCPs could be configured to be global?

Just leaving this here for anyone with a similar issue: In my case it was a ton of plugins calling npm on startup for update check and my ISP having known issues with slow npm calls. What helped was using npm registry to find the closest mirror. Cuts down startup time by at least 5x. 

Opencode would massively benefit from a more verbose startup for sure. 

`npm config set registry https://registry.npmmirror.com`

Additional reference for the Codex CLI implementation pattern:

- `prompt_cache_key` is set from the conversation id:
  - https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/af8a9d2d2ba84a1dafad6fa51fe3d63e96aceb75/codex-rs/core/src/client.rs#L734-L752

- WebSocket create supports `previous_response_id`:
  - type definition:
    - https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/af8a9d2d2ba84a1dafad6fa51fe3d63e96aceb75/codex-rs/codex-api/src/common.rs#L197-L214
  - set on follow-up turns:
    - https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/af8a9d2d2ba84a1dafad6fa51fe3d63e96aceb75/codex-rs/core/src/client.rs#L852-L856

- Incremental input reuse logic (append-only extension check + delta slicing):
  - baseline/delta computation:
    - https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/af8a9d2d2ba84a1dafad6fa51fe3d63e96aceb75/codex-rs/core/src/client.rs#L782-L819
  - actual slice:
    - https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/af8a9d2d2ba84a1dafad6fa51fe3d63e96aceb75/codex-rs/core/src/client.rs#L811-L815
  - tests asserting `previous_response_id` + incremental payload behavior:
    - https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/af8a9d2d2ba84a1dafad6fa51fe3d63e96aceb75/codex-rs/core/tests/suite/client_websockets.rs#L1145-L1183
    - https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/af8a9d2d2ba84a1dafad6fa51fe3d63e96aceb75/codex-rs/core/tests/suite/client_websockets.rs#L1264-L1297

For this issue, PR #20848 already covers the critical part (persisting/reusing response id in OpenCode).
Incremental-input slicing can be a follow-up optimization if desired.

Update: this is now fully covered in PR #20848.

In addition to the original `previous_response_id` persistence/reuse fix, the branch now also includes a cache-hit follow-up for SDK-based OpenAI providers:
- `promptCacheKey` is now applied for `@ai-sdk/openai` and `@ai-sdk/github-copilot` (not only `providerID === "openai"`).
